rec: Grand exchange teleport to access the Mine Cart from there

st.t: If you aren't in Keldagrim yet, go down the trapdoor in the north-west of the Grand Exchange and choose "Yes please." to ride there. Talk to Commander Veldaban, just west of the bank.
s: Sounds like just the job for me!

st.t: Talk to the Drunken Dwarf in east Keldagrim, north-east of the kebab shop.
s: I need to know about the Red Axe...

st.t: Give the Drunken Dwarf a beer, then talk to him again.
s: I need to know about the Red Axe...

st.t: Talk to the Rowdy Dwarf roaming the east Keldagrim pub, then give him the item he requests.
Buy a ticket from a cart conductor in south-east Keldagrim: choose "I'd like to buy a ticket.", "To White Wolf Mountain." and "Buy." Take the cart to White Wolf Mountain, then talk to Khorvak.
s: What if I offer you a drink?

st.t: Give Khorvak a dwarven stout. He's in the pub in the tunnel under White Wolf Mountain. If you didn't bring a stout, pick one up from the table in that pub.
s: What if I offer you a drink?

st.t: Buy a ticket from the cart conductor under White Wolf Mountain: choose "I'd like to buy a ticket." and "Buy." Take the cart back to Keldagrim. Talk to Gauss in the bar south of the bank in west Keldagrim. Have a beer with you for his toast.
Talk to Rind the gardener at the hops patch in west Keldagrim, just east of the bank.
Rake the hops patch just north of Rind, then plant the kelda seeds in it. There is a rake just south of the patch if you need one.
Wait for the kelda hops to grow. This'll take 15-20 minutes.
Harvest the kelda hops.
Go upstairs in Keldagrim's east pub to the brewing room.
Pick up the pot in the brewing room.
Buy yeast from Blandebir. You can get a pot from the table in the brewing room.
s: Do you have any spare ale yeast?
That's a good deal - please fill my pot with ale yeast for 25GP.

st.t: Add 2 buckets of water to the vat.
Add 2 barley malts to the vat.
Add the kelda hops to the vat.
Add the yeast to the vat.
Wait for the kelda to brew. This'll take 15-20 minutes.
Go back upstairs in Keldagrim's east pub if you left, then turn the valve on the vat.
Use a beer glass on the vat's barrel.
Go downstairs and give the Drunken Dwarf the kelda stout, then talk to him again.
s: I need to know about the Red Axe...

st.t: Talk to the south most cart conductor in south east Keldagrim.
Go up to the Consortium and talk to the Director of the company you joined in The Giant Dwarf. If you don't remember which company it was, try each director: only yours has time to talk to you.
s: Can you help me with a boarded up tunnel?

st.t: Go back down from the Consortium and take the cart in the south of the cart station. Both hands must be free.
Search the box.
Use the dwarven machinery.

Tap the first junction, at the far left of the map, until it holds the yellow stone. Each tap changes a junction: empty, green, yellow, then empty again. Green sends the cart along the upper track and yellow along the lower track.
Follow the lower track to the next junction. Tap it until it holds the green stone. The green line shows the cart's route, and it should now reach the end of the track.
Tap the Ok button.
Take the cart.
Search the box.
Take the cart back.
